name: The Vienna Game & Gambit
description: Levy Rozman's favorite weapon! White develops the c3 knight first, keeps options open, and then unleashes the devastating f4 gambit to crush Black's center and blast open the f-file.

chapters.title: Vienna Gambit (3. f4 d5!)
chapters.subtitle: Blasting open the f-file against 2... Nf6

steps.title: The Vienna Knight
steps.explanation: We develop our Queenside knight first, controlling d5 and keeping the f-pawn unblocked for an immediate f4 push!

steps.title: Black's Most Popular Move
steps.explanation: Black attacks our e4 pawn, thinking this is a quiet game.

steps.title: The Vienna Gambit!
steps.explanation: BOOM! The signature strike. We attack Black's e5 pawn with f4! If Black captures 3... exf4?, we push 4. e5! kicking their knight and taking total control.
steps.warning: If Black plays 3... exf4?, play 4. e5 Qe7 5. Qe2 winning a piece!

steps.title: Black's Best Counterpunch
steps.explanation: Black strikes back in the center.

steps.title: Win the Center & Kick Knight
steps.explanation: We capture on e5 with our pawn, forcing Black's knight to jump into danger on e4.
